name: Lucky
summary: Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus give you Advantage or attackers Disadvantage; refill on a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Luck Points
benefits.summary: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regained on a Long Rest.
benefits.text: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus, which you spend on this feat's other benefits. You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Advantage
benefits.summary: Spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on a D20 Test.
benefits.text: When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on that roll.

benefits.name: Disadvantage
benefits.summary: Spend 1 Luck Point to give an attack roll against you Disadvantage.
benefits.text: When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give that roll Disadvantage.
